privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Decide what your friends can see. Nobody else ever sees your training data.
privacy.discoverableHelp: Others can find you by name or username. They only see your username, first name and profile picture.
privacy.neverShared: Reflections on why a session went well or badly and your motivation are never shared, unless you choose to share a specific session.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently deletes your account, training data, reports, weight history and all uploaded photos. This can't be undone.
delete.confirmText: Everything is deleted immediately and permanently. Enter your password to confirm.
delete.done: Your account and all your data have been deleted.

about.title: About PACE
about.text: PACE helps athletes train with more discipline and consistency: a training calendar, a personal performance dashboard, weekly reports and friends who keep each other motivated.
about.privacy: Privacy comes first. Your data is only visible to you unless you choose to share it, and deleting your account deletes everything.
